title: Determine exact four-qubit width-twelve Gram nullity
body:
**Scoped native-algebra result: the full four-qubit Clifford Gram matrix at tensor width twelve has exact nullity 10,677,394 and exact rank 12,128,658,199,406.** Only the inflated Sp(8,2) rows 9 and 22, of degrees 595 and 3213, are absent. Every nonzero Pauli-character sector occurs. This makes [PR #7766](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7766)'s lower bound exact. **No new kappa** follows; T(4)=13 is unchanged.

Read the [proof and complete nullspace projector](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff9bdc0e82e75ab5ed39f3ff034ac8ddb3ea06d2/research/clifford-width-twelve-nullity/PROOF.md), [certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff9bdc0e82e75ab5ed39f3ff034ac8ddb3ea06d2/research/clifford-width-twelve-nullity/RESULT.json), [all 81 character columns](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff9bdc0e82e75ab5ed39f3ff034ac8ddb3ea06d2/research/clifford-width-twelve-nullity/CHARACTER-COLUMNS.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff9bdc0e82e75ab5ed39f3ff034ac8ddb3ea06d2/research/clifford-width-twelve-nullity/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff9bdc0e82e75ab5ed39f3ff034ac8ddb3ea06d2/research/clifford-width-twelve-nullity/SOURCE-PINS.json), [external inputs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff9bdc0e82e75ab5ed39f3ff034ac8ddb3ea06d2/research/clifford-width-twelve-nullity/EXTERNAL.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff9bdc0e82e75ab5ed39f3ff034ac8ddb3ea06d2/research/clifford-width-twelve-nullity/CREDITS.md).

At width twelve the module is `End(V) tensor W11`. A nonzero Pauli line has an actual stabilizer character; after removing that character, its multiplicities are those of W11 restricted to a nonzero-vector stabilizer H. If an H irreducible were absent, its induction to Sp(8,2) could contain only the two missing rows. An induced character must vanish on classes that fix no nonzero vector. Two authenticated columns make that impossible:

| Table class | Nonzero fixed vectors | Row 9 | Row 22 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 9 | 0 | 10 | 0 |
| 25 | 0 | 0 | 3 |

The determinant is 30. Thus every H irreducible occurs. The proof accounts for all regular-sector dimensions and gives an implicit exact orthogonal projector onto the complete nullspace, using only the two inflated characters. It does not assume that the projective Clifford extension splits.

Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clifford-width-twelve-nullity
```

Both registered modes print:

```text
PASS_CLIFFORD_WIDTH_TWELVE_NULLITY
Exact nullity 10677394; exact rank 12128658199406; T(4)=13 unchanged
Derangement classes 9 and 25 give diagonal witness (10,3), determinant 30
All nonzero Pauli-character sectors occur; only inflated rows 9 and 22 are absent
65536 Pauli pairs; 1048576 literal entries; 5120 adjoint images; orbit sizes 1,255
```

The authenticated CTblLib 1.3.11 archive reproduces all four rational rows across all 81 classes and the unchanged source projection. Full row orthogonality and all fixed-dimension bins agree. Literal adjoint checks retain the actual Pauli-line signs and the Gaussian Hadamard convention. Changed character, repeated witness, fixed-vector and omitted-sign controls distinguish the necessary conditions. The published table is a mathematical input, not reconstructed from group multiplication.

Eighteen retained files are authenticated. The unchanged source, normal/optimized registered replay, optional archive command in the [README](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff9bdc0e82e75ab5ed39f3ff034ac8ddb3ea06d2/research/clifford-width-twelve-nullity/README.md), syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44443475508/job/135289807335) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Ali Romman (@aliromman) supplied the [W11 support and open width-twelve question](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7c2dd1868c70f0addce2c0a4d3220149452f14b/research/clifford-four-qubit-threshold/PROOF.md) and [literal routines and multiplicity checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7c2dd1868c70f0addce2c0a4d3220149452f14b/research/clifford-four-qubit-threshold/verify.py). Nick Petalas (@petalas) supplied [PR #7747](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7747)'s [projection](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff12ca358d601a21cd4b1f016b8a3a969ac44016/research/clifford-four-qubit-width-nine/PROJECTION.json) and [archive parser](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff12ca358d601a21cd4b1f016b8a3a969ac44016/research/clifford-four-qubit-width-nine/verify.py). alephnan (@alephnan) supplied the [Pauli-sector framework](https://github.com/alephnan/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f7f32a18dde54e67624a9ed9cc7e1b266d9585c0/research/clifford-three-qubit-threshold/PROOF.md) in [PR #6714](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6714). The character table credits the ATLAS and [Thomas Breuer's CTblLib](https://www.math.rwth-aachen.de/~Thomas.Breuer/ctbllib/ctbllib-1.3.11.tar.gz). All predecessor notices remain intact.

Full width-ten nullity, sharp conditioning, native realization and complete caller costs remain open. No full group, Gram matrix or projector was materialized. The full three-qubit suite, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged. No independent human/formal-kernel acceptance or global literature priority is claimed.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Source pins do not assert ancestry.
